reviewerRole: independent source reviewer; no map/draft edits
scope: 作成者のJOS修正行21件（既レビュー17と追加地理用例12:2/13:9/13:16/19:27）を固定WEB本文、現行JOSプロファイル/knownBy、能動的除外一覧で再照合。

observations: Lebo-Hamath entry at current line 152 names JOS13:5 and says it may be a geographical place rather than a city.
Chephar Ammoni current line 309 names JOS18:24/Benjamin.
Mizpeh of Judah row at line 338 names JOS15:38 and leaves equivalence to Benjamin Mizpeh uncertain.
Maralah at line343 names JOS19:11; source note at line645 cites “Maralah/Mareal”.
Iron at line292 names JOS19:38 and lists Yaroun as a tentative location.
No Naphoth-Dor-specific table entry found; current map relation is based on WEB translation form “heights of Dor”.
articleReadEvidence.caveat: The Wikipedia article does not independently verify candidate coordinates.

fixedWEB.text: Joshua made himself flint knives, and circumcised the sons of Israel at the hill of the foreskins.

entries.findingJa: 「hill of the foreskins」は既存「ギブアト・ハアラロト」プロフィールと対応。地形名として直接リンク。

fixedWEB.text: and to the kings who were on the north, in the hill country, in the Arabah south of Chinneroth, in the lowland, and in the heights of Dor on the west,

entries.findingJa: WEBの「heights of Dor」はナフォテ・ドルの訳語表現。relatedで控えめに結び、本文にない現代地点は付加していない。記事個別項は現行Wikipediaで確認できなかった。

fixedWEB.text: The LORD delivered them into the hand of Israel, and they struck them, and chased them to great Sidon, and to Misrephoth Maim, and to the valley of Mizpah eastward. They struck them until they left them no one remaining.

entries.findingJa: 明示された「Israel」を既存集合プロフィールへ追加。Great Sidon、Misrephoth Maim、valley of Mizpahも文中の追跡先として一致。

fixedWEB.text: Now these are the kings of the land, whom the children of Israel struck, and possessed their land beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon, and all the Arabah eastward:

entries.findingJa: 本文はアルノンの谷と記す。採用プロフィールは川/谷を同一点にしないと明示するため、広域Featureの参照として妥当だが一点同一視は避ける。

fixedWEB.text: Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the middle of the valley, and half Gilead, even to the river Jabbok, the border of the children of Ammon;

entries.findingJa: 本文はAroerがアルノン谷の縁にあること、谷中央を記す。river/valley複合プロフィールは同一点扱いを避けており、広域参照としてqualified。

fixedWEB.text: the king of Aphek, one; the king of Lassharon, one;

entries.findingJa: 本文のLassharonは既存Lasharon地名の綴り異形。

fixedWEB.text: and the land of the Gebalites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrise, from Baal Gad under Mount Hermon to the entrance of Hamath;

entries.findingJa: 「entrance of Hamath」はLebo-Hamathの訳語として関連づける。現行Wikipedia Joshua city tableのLebo-Hamath行はJOS13:5を挙げつつ「地理地点かもしれず町とは限らない」と記す。relatedは適切。

fixedWEB.text: from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain of Medeba to Dibon;

entries.findingJa: アルノン谷の縁・谷中の町という記述に river_of_arnon profileを広域参照として採用。川と谷を一点に併合しない。

fixedWEB.text: Their border was from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain by Medeba;

activeExcludedCandidates.reasonJa: 候補名がこの節本文にない。

entries.findingJa: アルノン谷とAroer境界文脈に合う。候補地名ではなく谷/川の広域IDであり profileが一点同一視を避ける。

fixedWEB.text: Moses gave an inheritance to the half-tribe of Manasseh. It was for the half-tribe of the children of Manasseh according to their families.

entries.findingJa: 本文はマナセ半部族への相続を記すが「東マナセ領」は編集上の地理単位。relatedとし、その限定が保たれる。

fixedWEB.text: Their border was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the villages of Jair, which are in Bashan, sixty cities.

entries.findingJa: バシャンとヤイルの村を境界として列挙し、東マナセ領の広域説明と関係する。全境界の断定はしていない。

fixedWEB.text: Half Gilead, Ashtaroth, and Edrei, the cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were for the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even for the half of the children of Machir according to their families.

activeExcludedCandidates.reasonJa: ManassehはMachirの父である祖先個人。既存JOS Manasseh IDは部族集団なので誤って割り当てない。

entries.findingJa: ギレアデ半分等の割当記述を同地域カードへrelated。父祖の個人Manassehを集合プロフィールに誤リンクせず除外理由を明記。

fixedWEB.text: and it went out southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and went up by the south of Kadesh Barnea, and passed along by Hezron, went up to Addar, and turned toward Karka;

activeExcludedCandidates.reasonJa: 候補名がこの節本文にない。

entries.findingJa: Addarは南境界の線上に明記され、既存プロフィールは町・遺跡を断定しない。

fixedWEB.text: Dilean, Mizpah, Joktheel,

entries.findingJa: ユダの町リストにMizpahを明記し、既存profileもJOS15:38のMizpeh of Judahに限定。記事が現代地点を不確定とするため座標主張なし。

fixedWEB.text: This was the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families. The border of their inheritance eastward was Ataroth Addar, to Beth Horon the upper.

activeExcludedCandidates.reasonJa: エフライム族の集団用法で、エフライム領の地名IDへ割り当てない。

entries.findingJa: 「Beth Horon the upper」と明記され、既存Upper Beth-Horon profileと一致。Ephraimは集団として扱い、領域IDへの誤リンクを避ける。

fixedWEB.text: Chephar Ammoni, Ophni, and Geba; twelve cities with their villages.

entries.findingJa: Chephar Ammoniは既存Chephar Hammoni profileと一致。現行Wikipedia table line 309も同節・ベニヤミンに対応。候補除外重複は解消。

fixedWEB.text: Zelah, Eleph, the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem), Gibeath, and Kiriath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.

activeExcludedCandidates.reasonJa: 候補名がこの節本文にない。

entries.findingJa: WEBは「the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem)」と明記。jerusalem_636を同じ都市のprimaryとして残し、別Jebus alias pinは抑制。未解決のGibeath/Eleph/Kiriath候補は不採用のまま。Zelaの重複excludeは解消。

fixedWEB.text: Their border went up westward, even to Maralah, and reached to Dabbesheth. It reached to the brook that is before Jokneam.

activeExcludedCandidates.reasonJa: 候補名がこの節本文にない。

entries.findingJa: 本文Maralahと既存Marealは異綴り対応。Wikipedia table line343はJOS19:11 Maralah、同ページ参考文献はMaralah/Mareal。

fixedWEB.text: The border turned around it on the north to Hannathon; and it ended at the valley of Iphtah El;

activeExcludedCandidates.reasonJa: 候補名がこの節本文にない。

entries.findingJa: Hannathonとvalley of Iphtah Elを明記。既存地名・谷IDへの対応は正確。

fixedWEB.text: It turned toward the sunrise to Beth Dagon, and reached to Zebulun, and to the valley of Iphtah El northward to Beth Emek and Neiel. It went out to Cabul on the left hand,

activeExcludedCandidates.reasonJa: 候補名がこの節本文にない。

entries.findingJa: 「valley of Iphtah El」を明記。19:14と同じ谷IDに追加するのは同名地域の継続用例。

fixedWEB.text: Iron, Migdal El, Horem, Beth Anath, and Beth Shemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.

activeExcludedCandidates.reasonJa: 候補名がこの節本文にない。

entries.findingJa: 本文のIronは既存Yiron IDの聖書時代名表記。現代キブツYir’onとの混同をせず、候補座標はprofileへ昇格させていない。Wikipedia Joshua city table line292 lists Iron, JOS19:38, and a tentative Yaroun location.

changeClosureJa: 旧報告での16行のentities/excludedCandidates重複は作者が能動的除外から取り除き、過去理由をhistoryへ移したため解消。JOS11:8に明示Israelも追加。固定本文一致とJOS current profile knownBy gateを再検証した。
limitationsJa: 内容判定qualifiedは本文上正しいが翻訳形・広域単位・歴史地理比定に留保が残る項目。failは構造/本文に新たな問題が見つかった場合に限る。
